messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — we're rebalancing tomorrow's RFC review slots. Two quick asks: (1) who can swap if needed, (2) confirm pre-reads are uploaded.
Maria: I can move my slot from 11:00 -> 14:00 if that helps. ping me which RFC to take.
Ashwin: I have a calendar conflict at 11:00, would prefer later. I can take any 14:00 slot.
Jordan: Thanks. Current author order: 1) infra-costs-rfc (Priyanka) 2) kv-cache-v2 (Maria) 3) routing-policy-update (Ashwin) 4) rollout-safety (Suzanne).
Priyanka: Pre-read uploaded to the doc: https://redwood.docs/r/infra-costs-rfc — comments open, please skim.
Suzanne: I can move rollout-safety earlier if it helps sequencing with infra-costs.
Maria: If Ashwin takes 3, I can take 2 at 14:00. That keeps KV before routing.
Jordan: Goal: keep related techs adjacent so reviewers can reference earlier points. New plan: 11:00 Priyanka, 12:00 Suzanne, 14:00 Maria, 15:00 Ashwin. 👍
Ashwin: 15:00 works for me. Thanks for the shuffle.
Priyanka: Can reviewers try to post quick pre-read notes by EOD? even 1-2 bullets helps.
Maria: Will do. I'll add a short highlights section at top of my doc.
Suzanne: Also, can we reserve the last 10m for follow-ups and action items? last time we ran long.
Jordan: Yep — block tables: 45m discussion + 10m actions. I'll update the agenda.
SchedBot: calendar: Updated event times and attendees. Meeting invite resent to channel.
Maria: small note — embedding benchmark screenshot in PR, use `png` not `svg` for Slack preview.
Jordan: Great catch. @Maria add to the RFC doc and tag reviewers.
Priyanka: done. thanks!
Ashwin: One more — can someone spot-check the perf numbers in the appendix? I'm not confident about the batch size assumptions.
Suzanne: I'll take a pass after standup and post any corrections inline.
Jordan: Awesome team. I'll post final agenda + pre-read checklist in 30m. If anyone needs a different time, call it out here.
Maria: all good from me. :thumbsup:
Ashwin: good.
Suzanne: good.
Priyanka: good.
